description: Calculate whole wallpaper rolls by vertical drops (not square feet) for US double rolls or European rolls with straight or half-drop pattern repeats.

height.description: Wall height (ft in us, default 8; m in metric, default 2.4).

length.description: Room length (ft in us, m in metric). Provide length+width OR wallWidth.

repeat.description: Pattern repeat length (in in us, cm in metric) when match is straight or half.

rollPreset.description: Roll preset: us205 (20.5 in × 33 ft), us27 (27 in × 27 ft), euro (53 cm × 10 m).

wallWidth.description: Total wall width to paper (ft in us, m in metric), e.g. for an accent wall.

width.description: Room width (ft in us, m in metric).

name: calculate_wallpaper
title: Wallpaper Roll Calculator
